svg.title: CoGenRec reconstruction pipeline
svg.desc: The two exposure-aware endpoint encoders and between-exposure TD/SD feed the bidirectional recurrent temporal propagator. Multi-scale features guide ControlNet and detail fusion. Stable Diffusion and the VAE decoder reconstruct RGB video.
